fichas.title: Ground and collector drainage pipes
fichas.summary: Guidance and two reference tables for permissible wastewater discharge in ground and collector drainage pipes. The tables give maximum discharge and velocity by nominal pipe size and fall for degrees of filling of 50% and 70%, corresponding to DIN EN 12056 Tables B.1 and B.2. The text specifies a minimum fall for collector pipes and a higher filling degree when a drain lift pump is connected.
uses: Sizing ground and collector drainage pipes
